name: signalsapi-plane-mcp
description: Local MCP server for the SignalsAPI agent data plane. Not hosted — run it yourself. Its tool list is read from openapi/plane-v1.yaml's x-mcp-tool operations at startup, and every call is proxied as a REST request to PLANE_MCP_BASE_URL (default: the local Prism mock from the fixture gallery, http://127.0.0.1:4010).
